Project Cloud Mary Jane Sneakers for Women Summer

Previous page
Next page
Previous page
Next page

Step into all-day comfort with the Project Cloud Summer, lightweight Mary Jane sneakers for women. These sneakers feature high density memory foam cushioning, a jersey sock lining, and a non-slip rubber outsole. Easy velcro strap for quick everyday wear.

  • Is this suitable for wide feet?

    Yes, the Summer features an adjustable velcro strap that customizes fit for narrow or wider feet. The roomy Mary Jane silhouette and lightweight flexible upper give wider feet a comfortable fit on these womens slip-on sneakers.

  • Does this fit true to size?

    Yes, the Summer runs true to size for most customers. We recommend referring to our size guide for accurate measurements. The adjustable velcro strap on these Mary Jane sneakers customizes fit for a comfortable, secure everyday wear.

  • How comfortable is the memory foam for all-day wear?

    Very comfortable — the Summer features our high density memory foam insole with plush cushioning that absorbs impact and reduces foot fatigue on these Mary Jane sneakers built for long days on your feet.

  • How durable is the upper and is the outsole non-slip on wet surfaces?

    The Summer features a water-resistant, lightweight flexible upper and a non-slip rubber outsole that delivers reliable traction on wet surfaces and slick floors. Durable strong stitching keeps these Mary Jane sneakers holding their shape.

  • What outfits do they pair well with and are they easy to slip on?

    Yes, the Summer's velcro strap makes them quick to wear with easy slip-on comfort. These versatile Mary Jane sneakers pair with jeans, dresses, work outfits, and weekend looks — blending fashion and practicality for everyday wear.

5 out of 5 stars
Best Dolce Vita Dupe and comfortable!
I had seen the Dolce Vita gold and silver ones at Nordstroms but didn’t want to pay $150. I have these in the black and cream so when saw Project Cloud had come out with the metallic dupe for Dolce- I knew I had to get them- and saved $$$. I love these! Heel is super cushioned so no rubbing and footbed is cushioned too. I’ve worn the other pair standing all day at work and were comfortable but more stylish than a sneaker. I wear size 7 in sandal but go up to 7.5 for tennis shoes or other closed toe shoes for wider toe box. These are fine in 7.5. I can’t wait to take these on my next trip as will be stylish for walking, shopping, dinner and go with everything.

    These are very cute and I like that they are leather and not PU. The inside feels like a neoprene synthethic fabric and the bottoms are smooth like vinyl. There is no loop closure, but a strap with velcro. It seems to hold well. I am a size 6, (size 36) pretty consistently. I tried both the 5.5 and 6 and the 6 felt best. They have a thin layer of memory foam on the insole, limited padding, and almost no arch support so they will not be something that I will wear for long days or long walks. But they are a great casual addition. I should note that I also ordered a similar pair by Lucky Step that seemed great with a bit more padding, but their size 6 is a 37 and was about 1/2 size too big, with no smaller option.
